description: Provider readiness states contract - clear separation of concerns

PROVIDER_UNCONFIGURED.description: No provider configuration exists in registry
criteria: No role mappings for any role

PROVIDER_CONFIGURED.description: Provider configuration exists in registry (base_url, model, auth_type)
criteria: At least one ProviderConfiguration exists with enabled=true
PROVIDER_CONFIGURED.excludes: Does NOT imply credential is present or valid

PROVIDER_CREDENTIALED.description: Credential is present in secrets store for the provider
PROVIDER_CREDENTIALED.excludes: Does NOT imply network reachability or model call success

PROVIDER_REACHABLE.description: Network probe to provider endpoint succeeded
criteria: HTTP probe to provider base_url returned 2xx/401 (not network error)
Probe classification: READY or AUTH_FAILED (not NETWORK_ERROR, NOT_FOUND)
PROVIDER_REACHABLE.excludes: Does NOT imply model call success (could be auth failure, model not found, etc.)
actions_possible: Attempt model call with valid credential

MODEL_CALLABLE.description: Actual model inference succeeded (real token generation)
criteria: Real model call executed via provider API
Received valid response with tokens generated
MODEL_CALLABLE.excludes: This is E32 (real model execution), NOT E32A

state_transitions.UNCONFIGURED -> CONFIGURED: Add provider record + configuration + role mappings
state_transitions.REACHABLE -> MODEL_CALLABLE: Execute real model call (E32, not E32A)

current_state_e32a.nvidia: CREDENTIALED (secret in store, config in registry, roles mapped)
current_state_e32a.openai_compatible: CREDENTIALED (secret in store, config in registry, thinker role mapped)
current_state_e32a.zai_internal: CONFIGURED (config in registry, NO secret in store, auth_type=config_file)

e32a_scope: Validates up to PROVIDER_CREDENTIALED state. Does NOT execute network probes or model calls.
